summary: Attractor reconstruction reveals albedo is governed by a LOW-DIMENSIONAL system (correlation dimension ~1.9, embedding dimension 3) but with WEAKLY CHAOTIC dynamics (Lyapunov exponent +0.0031, barely positive). This means: (1) albedo variability is controlled by only ~2 effective degrees of freedom — strongly supporting H002's claim that invariant properties constrain the system. (2) But the marginally positive Lyapunov exponent means intrinsic dynamics alone don't guarantee stability — some external mechanism (possibly cloud buffering H001) must keep the system from diverging. NH determinism (0.73) is much higher than SH (0.33), suggesting NH albedo is more predictable/constrained than SH.
